design-rate-limiter.title: Design a Distributed Rate Limiter
design-rate-limiter.description: Design a system that can limit the number of requests a user can make to an API in a distributed environment.
design-rate-limiter.realWorldUse: API throttling, DDoS protection, fair resource allocation
functionalRequirements: Limit API requests per user/IP within a configurable time window
Support different rate limiting rules per API endpoint
Return clear error responses (HTTP 429) when limit exceeded
Allow burst traffic within acceptable bounds
nonFunctionalRequirements: Low latency — rate check must complete in < 10ms
High availability — must not become a single point of failure
Distributed — must work consistently across multiple server instances
Eventually consistent — small over-allowance is acceptable

constraints.ruleGranularity: Per user, per IP, per endpoint

design-url-shortener.title: Design a URL Shortener (TinyURL)
design-url-shortener.description: Design a service that takes a long URL and generates a short, unique alias for it.
design-url-shortener.realWorldUse: Marketing campaigns, link tracking, QR codes
functionalRequirements: Given a long URL, generate a unique short URL
Redirect short URL to original long URL with minimal latency
Allow optional custom short aliases
Track click analytics (count, referrer, geo)
nonFunctionalRequirements: High availability — URL redirection must always work
Low latency — redirect should complete in < 50ms
Short URLs should not be guessable (avoid sequential IDs)
System should handle 100:1 read-to-write ratio

design-distributed-cache.title: Design a Distributed Cache
design-distributed-cache.description: Design a highly available and scalable distributed cache system like Redis or Memcached.
design-distributed-cache.realWorldUse: Session storage, CDN, database query optimization
functionalRequirements: Support GET, SET, DELETE operations with TTL
Distribute data across multiple cache nodes
Handle cache eviction (LRU, LFU, TTL-based)
Support atomic operations for race condition prevention
nonFunctionalRequirements: Sub-millisecond read latency for cached data
Horizontal scalability — add nodes without downtime
High availability — survive node failures with replication
Consistent hashing for minimal key redistribution

design-notification-system.title: Design a Notification System
design-notification-system.description: Design a robust notification system for push, SMS, and email with priority queues and retries.
functionalRequirements: Send notifications via push, SMS, and email channels
Support priority levels (urgent, high, normal, low)
Retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff
Allow users to configure notification preferences
Support template-based notification content
nonFunctionalRequirements: High throughput — handle millions of notifications per day
At-least-once delivery guarantee
Real-time for push, near-real-time for email/SMS
Graceful degradation when third-party providers are down

design-metrics-monitoring.title: Design a Metrics Monitoring System
design-metrics-monitoring.description: Design a real-time metrics collection and alerting system for infrastructure health.
functionalRequirements: Collect metrics from thousands of servers (CPU, memory, disk, network)
Store time-series data efficiently with configurable retention
Support real-time dashboards and historical queries
Trigger alerts based on thresholds and anomaly detection
Downsample old data to save storage
nonFunctionalRequirements: Handle millions of metrics data points per second
Query latency < 1s for dashboard rendering
High write throughput — append-only workload
Fault tolerant — monitoring must survive partial failures

design-unique-id-generator.title: Design a Distributed Unique ID Generator
design-unique-id-generator.description: Design a system that generates unique and sortable IDs in a distributed environment.
functionalRequirements: Generate globally unique IDs across all nodes
IDs must be roughly time-sortable
Support high throughput ID generation (10K+ per second per node)
IDs should fit in 64 bits for efficient storage and indexing
nonFunctionalRequirements: No coordination between nodes required for generation
Low latency — ID generation must be < 1ms
Monotonically increasing within a single node
Survive clock skew across data centers

design-proximity-service.title: Design a Proximity Service (Yelp)
design-proximity-service.description: Design a system to find nearby places like restaurants or gas stations within a specific radius.
design-proximity-service.realWorldUse: Location search, restaurant discovery, nearby services
functionalRequirements: Search for businesses within a given radius of user's location
Filter results by category, rating, price range
Return results ranked by distance and relevance
Business owners can add/update/delete their listings
nonFunctionalRequirements: Low latency — search results in < 200ms
High availability — location search must always work
Read-heavy workload (1000:1 read-to-write ratio)
Handle location updates efficiently

design-cloud-storage.title: Design Dropbox / Google Drive
design-cloud-storage.description: Design a secure and efficient cloud file storage and synchronization service.
functionalRequirements: Upload, download, and sync files across multiple devices
Support file versioning and rollback
Handle large files efficiently using chunked uploads
Share files/folders with other users with permissions
Real-time sync notifications across devices
nonFunctionalRequirements: High durability — never lose a file (99.999999999%)
Bandwidth efficient — only sync changed blocks (delta sync)
Handle conflicts when same file edited on multiple devices
Support offline editing with eventual sync

design-distributed-sql.title: Design a Distributed SQL Database
design-distributed-sql.description: How to design a scalable SQL database with ACID properties and horizontal partitioning.
design-distributed-sql.realWorldUse: Global databases, multi-region apps, ACID transactions
functionalRequirements: Support standard SQL queries (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
Maintain ACID transaction guarantees across shards
Horizontally partition data across nodes (sharding)
Support multi-region replication with strong consistency
nonFunctionalRequirements: Strong consistency for transactions (linearizability)
Horizontal scalability — add nodes to increase capacity
Fault tolerant — survive node and even region failures
Acceptable latency trade-off for global consistency

design-web-crawler.title: Design a Web Crawler
design-web-crawler.description: Design a scalable web crawler to index the internet. Handle politeness, duplicate detection, and high-throughput.
design-web-crawler.realWorldUse: Search indexing, price monitoring, data aggregation
functionalRequirements: Crawl billions of web pages and extract content
Follow links using BFS/priority-based traversal
Respect robots.txt and crawl politeness rules
Detect and avoid duplicate/near-duplicate pages
Support incremental re-crawling for freshness
nonFunctionalRequirements: High throughput — crawl 1B+ pages per week
Distributed — run across hundreds of machines
Fault tolerant — resume after partial failures
Politeness — don't overwhelm any single domain

design-ride-sharing.title: Design Uber / Lyft
design-ride-sharing.description: Design a real-time ride-sharing service with matching, routing, and location tracking.
functionalRequirements: Riders request rides with pickup/dropoff locations
Match riders with nearby available drivers in real-time
Track driver location in real-time during the ride
Calculate fare based on distance, time, and surge pricing
Support trip history and ratings
nonFunctionalRequirements: Real-time matching — find driver in < 30 seconds
Location updates at 3-5 second intervals
High availability — ride requests always processed
Handle geographic hotspots (events, rush hour)

design-youtube.title: Design YouTube
design-youtube.description: Design a video sharing platform like YouTube with video upload, processing, and streaming capabilities.
functionalRequirements: Upload videos in various formats and resolutions
Transcode videos into multiple formats/resolutions (adaptive bitrate)
Stream videos with minimal buffering
Support video search, recommendations, and trending
Like, comment, subscribe, and share functionality
nonFunctionalRequirements: Low startup latency for video playback (< 2s)
Global CDN — serve videos close to users worldwide
Handle viral content — massive traffic spikes
Cost-efficient storage for petabytes of video

design-whatsapp.title: Design WhatsApp
design-whatsapp.description: Design a real-time messaging system with end-to-end encryption and delivery status.
design-whatsapp.realWorldUse: Messaging apps, team collaboration, customer support
functionalRequirements: Send and receive text, image, and video messages in real-time
Support 1:1 and group chats
Show message delivery status (sent, delivered, read)
End-to-end encryption for message privacy
Offline message storage and delivery on reconnect
nonFunctionalRequirements: Real-time delivery — message latency < 500ms
High availability — messaging always works
Ordered message delivery within a conversation
Support millions of concurrent WebSocket connections

design-ticketmaster.title: Design Ticketmaster
design-ticketmaster.description: Design an online ticketing system that handles high-concurrency during popular sales.
design-ticketmaster.realWorldUse: Event ticketing, concert sales, flash sales
functionalRequirements: Browse events and view available seats/sections
Reserve and purchase tickets with seat selection
Handle concurrent purchases — prevent double-booking
Support ticket hold/timeout for payment window
Virtual waiting queue for high-demand events
nonFunctionalRequirements: Handle extreme traffic spikes (100K+ concurrent users per event)
Strong consistency — no double-selling of tickets
Low latency during checkout flow
Fair queuing — first-come, first-served ordering

design-news-feed.title: Design Facebook News Feed
design-news-feed.description: Design a news feed system that aggregates and ranks updates from friends and pages.
design-news-feed.realWorldUse: Social feeds, news aggregation, content recommendations
functionalRequirements: Publish posts (text, images, videos, links)
Generate personalized news feed from friends/follows
Rank and sort feed items by relevance and recency
Support like, comment, share interactions on posts
Real-time feed updates for new posts
nonFunctionalRequirements: Feed generation latency < 500ms
Handle celebrity users with millions of followers
Support both push (fan-out on write) and pull (fan-out on read)
Eventually consistent — slight delay for non-celebrity posts is OK
